name: vouch
description: Skills for installing and operating the vouch allow-list permission gate with Codex and Claude Code; vouch-setup provisions from evidence, vouch-status reports installed versus released versions, and vouch-update moves the gate on an explicit accept.

interface.shortDescription: An allow-list gate for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Install, configure, inspect, and operate vouch as a local tool-call gate for Codex or Claude Code.
defaultPrompt: Set up vouch for this coding agent.
Check my installed vouch versions against the newest release.
Explain why vouch blocked this tool call.
Review my vouch configuration from evidence.
